description:
-= Basement =-
Well, here we are in the basement.

You can see a non-euclidean safe. Wow, check out the price tag that the non-euclidean safe's owner still hasn't taken off! Thirty bucks! You see a gleam over in a corner, where you can see a display. Make a note of this, you might have to put stuff on or in it later on. The display contains a non-euclidean latchkey.

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going west.
objective: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First stop, retrieve the non-euclidean latchkey from the display. With the non-euclidean latchkey, lock the non-euclidean safe inside the basement. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
